name: Stalker Jingai ni Yuukaisaremashita
original_name: ストーカー人外に誘拐されました
source:
You have been kidnapped by a non-human, self-proclaimed stalker. You have started a strange life under house arrest with an alien who loves you too much! Will you be freed unscathed?

This is a visual novel game in which you make choices and enjoy interacting with Selmoni, the stalker alien. You can choose to be friendly or to be cruel. Find your favorite ending!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11521]Novelgame[/url].]
